Apple yesterday unveiled the all-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 lineup, alongside the debut of AirPods 5. The new products will officially go on sale next Friday, September 18.

Before the official launch, Apple's new product lineup is already available for pre-order on Amazon.

AirPods 5

First, Apple's new AirPods 5 come with more features but at a lower price. For example, both AirPods 5 models now feature active noise cancellation — an upgrade over the previous-generation AirPods 4. However, there are some differences between the two — the lower-tier model lacks volume control via the stem and does not come with a wireless charging case. As for the higher-tier model, battery life is extended by roughly one hour.

I've been using the AirPods 5 for a few hours now, and I'm genuinely impressed by the ANC improvements. I'll share more detailed impressions later.

Apple Watch Series 12

At the same time, the new Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 both represent a major leap in health-tracking capabilities. Apple calls this the all-new "Health Sensing System," which enables higher-frequency heart rate and HRV sensing, supporting a brand-new "readiness score" feature. It also introduces new Audio Intelligence features, including Live Rewind and Siri Recap.

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm $399
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm $449
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm GPS + Cell $490 (original price $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm GPS + Cell $549
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Titanium $699
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Titanium $729 (original price $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic $949

All-new Apple Watch band colours

Finally, several new Apple Watch bands are on sale on Amazon. I tried these new colours in person for a while, and I'm particularly fond of the new translucent Ocean Band style.

  • All-new Trail Loop $99 — Sand, Dark Umber, Burgundy
  • All-new Ocean Band $99 — Translucent Kelp, Gray and Black
  • All-new Alpine Loop $99 — Desert, Dark Olive and Burgundy

Are you planning to pick up the new Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, or AirPods 5? Let us know in the comments.
